title: I made Fresh Ice, a browser game where you drive the ice resurfacer between periods
author: ABS-Game-Dev
selftext:
Game Title: Fresh Ice

Playable Link: https://freshice.app/?p=3

Platform: Web browser (phone and desktop)

Description: Fresh Ice puts you in the driver's seat of the ice resurfacer between periods. Swipe to steer, and the machine drives dead straight until something stops it, so every level is a little route puzzle against the clock. Clean every scratch before puck drop. There are ten rinks, from a backyard rink and Glacier Lake to the Granite Curling Club and a Stadium Classic, and each brings a twist: fans throw things on the ice, your snow tank fills and has to be dumped, and in Rival Race the rink across town sends its own machine to clean the same sheet. Pick up power-ups on the ice and spend your tips in The Shed. Levels never run out. It plays in any browser on a phone or a computer, with no download or sign-up, and you can sign in or use a transfer code to carry your progress between devices. I'd love to hear what's fun, what's frustrating, and how far you got.
